Multiplicative depth of functional bootstrapping

Source: R/functional-bootstrapping.R
get_fbt_depth.Rd

get_fbt_depth() gives the depth eval_fbt() consumes for a look-up table, and get_fefbt_depth() the depth eval_fe_func_bootstrap() consumes for a Fourier series. Add the levels wanted after bootstrapping to get the multiplicative_depth of the context.

Usage

get_fbt_depth(
  level_budget,
  coefficients,
  p_input,
  order,
  skd,
  first_mod_size = 60L
)

get_fefbt_depth(
  level_budget,
  coefficients,
  skd = SecretKeyDist$SPARSE_TERNARY,
  first_mod_size = 60L
)

Arguments

level_budget

Integer vector of length 2; the levels spent on the coefficients-to-slots and slots-to-coefficients transforms.

coefficients

The coefficients of the look-up table (as for eval_fbt()) or of the Fourier series.

p_input

The input plaintext modulus: a string of decimal digits, or a whole number of at most 2^53.

order

Integer; the order of the Hermite interpolation.

skd

Secret key distribution, an element of SecretKeyDist.

first_mod_size

Integer; size of the first modulus in bits (read only for SecretKeyDist$SPARSE_ENCAPSULATED). Default 60L.

Value

An integer.
